description: Main source file for a Flutter-based personal notes application, including widget definitions, state management, database interactions, and UI components.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: Model representing a personal note with id, title, content, and last updated timestamp.

classes.name: NotesLocalDatabase
classes.description: Singleton class managing CRUD operations with SQLite database for notes.

classes.name: NotesProvider
classes.description: State management class extending ChangeNotifier, handling notes list and CRUD operations.

classes.name: NotesHomeScreen
classes.description: Main screen displaying list of notes with search, add, edit, and delete functionalities.

classes.name: NotesSearchDelegate
classes.description: Custom SearchDelegate to handle real-time searching of notes.

classes.name: NoteEditorScreen
classes.description: Screen for creating a new note or editing an existing one.

classes.name: NoteDetailsScreen
classes.description: Screen showing detailed view of a note with options to edit or delete.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point of the Flutter app, initializes the widget tree with NotesApp.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Build method for various widgets, including main app, screens, and list items.

methods.name: _saveNote
methods.description: Handles saving or updating a note, invoked from the editor screen.

methods.name: _openEditor
methods.description: Navigates to the note editor screen for creating or editing.

methods.name: _openDetails
methods.description: Navigates to the note detail view.

methods.name: _delete
methods.description: Deletes a note after user confirmation.
